code_observations: Code observation, unverified as to intent (Análise dos Dados Nota Técnica.R line 177): the filter entry with an acute accent before 45 matches 0 rows, so party 45 (711 programs) is not in the Figura 5 table. The paper's Figura 5 legend also omits 45, so printed T5/T6 equal the deposited code's output. Deposited filter covers 0.490412119927958 of rows; with '45' it covers 0.565737895963556 (text says the selected parties exceed 50%). EXPLORATORY rerun with '45' (not pre-registered): PT expected 557.761235955056 vs observed 602; chisq p 8.28203853764049e-40. Sources: outputs/party_share_check.csv, outputs/robustness.json.

Not affecting results: rio::import (readxl) guesses column types from the first rows and turns every value of sequencial_tse (6959 values), raca_tse (2800 values) into NA; the script never uses these columns. Source: outputs/import_coercion_check_v1.csv.

class_reason: All six targets match the paper at its printed rounding after the pre-registered path-only file-name mapping (primary file bd_doxa_programas_HGPE.xlsx); the v2 programs file gives identical values (alternative class A). Whether the renamed files make the materials unclear (C) is a lead reading under PREREG section 4.
confidence_reason: Numbers matched by script, but the class rests on the file-name mapping judgment and B's run is not yet compared.
uncertainties: The script reads two file names that are not in the deposit; the mapping to the _HGPE files is a pre-registered path-only fix, but nothing in the deposit says which programs file the authors used (v1 and v2 give identical target values here).
T2/T3 come from ggpubr::stat_cor, which rounds r to 2 decimals; the match is also checked with unrounded cor.test values in the notes.
Paper note 9 prints an expected 2018 APE4 count of 16; the code gives 16.87 (secondary number, not a target).
The paper prints 'p-valor > 0,001' for Figura 4; the code gives p far below 0.001 (pre-registered reading (1)).
CRAN ggplot2 4.0.3 was pulled into the per-run library as a dependency and masks system ggplot2 3.5.1; stat_cor output was read via layer_data under 4.0.3.
Secondary robustness quantity r(2018)-r(2002) is not stable: near zero after outlier exclusion and negative under Spearman (robustness.json). Primary checks all pass.
